newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade in light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade in light test - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers near steady in a light test. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest fairly light. Offerings current and moderate.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1275 lbs few 65.00-65.50 few Select and Choice low dressing 62.50.

Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Wednesday's close Slaughter steers and heifers near steady in a light test. Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1150-1275 lbs few 103.00 couple lds Choice old crop 105.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 98.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1100-1150 lbs few 103.00.
For the week - 32,000 Wk ago - 19,300 Yr ago - 40,000 Steers and heifers - Live basis - 1.00-1.50 lower. Carcass basis - mostly 2.00 lower.
Wk to Date - 29,800 Week Ago - 19,300 Year Ago - 40,000
